solve.method: Uncertainty-weighted nonlinear pinhole fit to 13 hand-read architectural points, with five held-out upper sills. Fixed eye height 2m, pixel aspect 1, zero skew. Fit minimizes source-coordinate error against the current reconstructed model. It cannot independently resolve absolute historical height or the basement/street datum.
solve.exposure: LEFT stereo half of full unchanged 2737x1360 card; all landmarks and principal point use full-card pixels. No points from the right exposure, no crop/scale transform.
solve.limits: Unknown original lens, stereo baseline and scan distortion. Fixed 2m eye height. Grade partly obscured; northeast grade excluded. Roof/cornice extents approximate projecting details. The fit does not resolve the conflicting archival height datum or establish a historical viewer location. Current model must still be rendered and inspected.
solve.lighting: Soft geometric review key only. Source shows cornice shadows, but no calibrated sunlight/weather reconstruction is claimed by this preliminary camera.
solve.ground: Common flat model grade only; no actual terrain or street survey verification.
solve.optical_degeneracy: The optimizer reaches its +5 degree roll bound and extrapolates principal x to about1550.72px, beyond the selected left exposure. These are model/camera/correspondence degeneracy warnings, not an accepted lens calibration or historical viewer position. All coordinates still refer to the full unmodified card; no right-exposure observations were fitted.
